title: HIIT Fire Assist UX/UI
summary: A UX case study for a smartwatch workout app aimed at hands-free, low-attention use during exercise. The write-up moves from product user challenges and a user persona to task mapping and the final round-watch screens, such as mode selection and a session summary showing calories, time and heart rate.

title: YouTube Music UX/UI Redesign Case Study
summary: A redesign case study of the YouTube Music app. It is organised as numbered problems, each paired with a proposed solution shown on dark-theme mobile screens, such as dynamic lyrics, a reworked bottom navigation and moving the radio option out of the queue, plus a redesigned downloads screen.

title: Spotify UX/UI Redesign Case Study
summary: A redesign case study of Spotify across desktop and mobile. Each numbered problem is followed by a solution mock-up in the dark interface, including bulk selection of songs, tabbed artist discographies and a simpler now-playing action bar.
